purpose: Primary sources supporting design choices and verified Promptfoo integration names; none contains Jev results.
notes: Web documentation is mutable. Archive or pin applicable upstream commit/version before a confirmatory run.
Access dates follow the task's local date. Some live pages displayed later update dates; those dates are not evidence that an installed package supports the documented feature.
No attack-success estimate from a vendor page or another model is used as a Jev performance claim.
Fixture imports require independent license, provenance, and contamination review.
Protocol sampling and analysis choices are this suite's proposed design, rather than requirements imposed by these sources.
